ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with sparse high-intensity (white/grey) pixel clusters at distal and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white/grey mottling concentrated at the distal tip of the upper-left lobe. A secondary, thin vertical high-intensity streak is located proximal to the median notch on the left lobe's inner surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex angle estimated at 45-50 degrees, providing a deep division between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; frequency is higher and more jagged on the upper-left lobe compared to the smoother visible arc of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upper-left lobe displays a slightly convex curve leading to a tapered tip; right lobe displays a broader convex curvature before intersecting the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of roughly circular high-contrast white spots visible at the extreme tip of the upper-left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetric pigmentation distribution where light-colored features are restricted almost exclusively to the left lobe tip and notch area.
